title: Track a generator for the embedded UI SPIR-V header
body: The tracked UiShaderSpirv.g.h describes packing glslc outputs with a script, but no generator existed in the repository. I added libraries/RenderGraph/src/Ui/shaders/regenerate-ui-shader-header.py to compile both UI shaders and regenerate that header; promote this into the supported generated-artifact workflow so renderer shader changes stay reproducible.
